business_summary: Choil Aluminum Co., Ltd. operates as an aluminum rolling company in South Korea. The company provides secondary battery, automobile, aluminum foils, electrical and electronic components, construction materials, PP CAP, and railroad products. Choil Aluminum Co., Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Gyeongsan-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 초일알루미늄주식회사는 한국에서 알루미늄 압연 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 2차전지, 자동차, 알루미늄박, 전기전자부품, 건축자재, PP CAP, 철도용품 등을 공급하는 회사입니다. 초일알루미늄주식회사는 1975년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 경산시에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
